x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

def compute_gcd(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

def evaluate_ratio(x, y, b, a):
    global min_num, min_den, a_best, b_best
    if a < 0:
        return
    g = compute_gcd(a, b)
    a //= g
    b //= g
    numerator = abs(b * x - a * y)
    denominator = b * y
    g2 = compute_gcd(numerator, denominator)
    numerator //= g2
    denominator //= g2
    if numerator * min_den < min_num * denominator:
        min_num = numerator
        min_den = denominator
        a_best = a
        b_best = b
        return
    if numerator * min_den == denominator * min_num:
        if b < b_best:
            a_best = a
            b_best = b
            return
        if b > b_best:
            return
        if a < a_best:
            a_best = a
            b_best = b
            return

min_num, min_den = 100000, 1
a_best, b_best = 0, 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    evaluate_ratio(x, y, i, (i * x) // y)
    evaluate_ratio(x, y, i, (i * x) // y + 1)
    evaluate_ratio(x, y, i, (i * x) // y - 1)

print(f"{a_best}/{b_best}")
